decisions.reason: The online customer portal supports the firm's integrated one-stop execution and brand collaboration strategy, and the firm can build on its existing order and logistics processes to improve it.
The packaging display solution draws directly on core board-design knowledge and won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, an external sign of value the firm can use and develop further.
A quarter-pallet pegboard display is a close extension of the firm's established display competence and has its own page, so the firm can readily read early market feedback and refine the design.
Small counter displays sit squarely within the firm's existing design, printing and assembly know-how, so keeping them costs little and fits its broader 3D cardboard direction.

The large freestanding information display builds on related structural and printing knowledge, though it is somewhat more distant from the firm's promotional core and its first results are still unclear.
